Get started.

  1. Sign in with Codex CLI

    Install Codex CLI, then run codex login.

  2. Download GPT Voice

    Open the DMG and drag GPT Voice to Applications. Then allow the microphone and Accessibility. Quit GPT Voice before updating.

    Mac download coming soon

    Signing is in progress. Build from source for now.

    Press ⌃⌥Space

    Talk, then press it again.

Not notarized by Apple

This preview is development-signed but not notarized, so macOS may block the first open. You can also build it from source.

If macOS says Apple can't check or verify GPT Voice, or that its developer is unidentified, open System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.

If it says GPT Voice will damage your computer, don't open it. Move it to the Trash and report the exact message.

Do I need an API key?

No. It reuses the file-backed ChatGPT session from Codex CLI.

Where does my audio go?

To ChatGPT for transcription, over a private route that can change. Recordings are temporary files on your Mac. There's no offline mode.

Will my ChatGPT plan work?

Access depends on your ChatGPT account. Limits can vary, and this private route can change.

Which Macs?

macOS 13 or later, Apple Silicon and Intel. One download covers both.
